review_scope: Static implementation-to-frozen-science-spec alignment plus independent rerun of authored synthetic model tests. Reviewer did not implement the model/runner/tests, but did write the science specification; this is not an independent scientific-design review.

checks.name: capacity_and_physical_removal
checks.finding: Each arm retains only its selected original 3x64 parameter: 192 local coefficients. The other Q/K kernel and V local kernel are absent, not frozen zero/dummy parameters. Relative original CNN576: -384; relative QK-only384: -192. Historical inactive GRU registration remains unchanged.

checks.name: common_qkv_and_v_projection
checks.finding: Common qkv object and all projector rows remain normally trainable; removing the local V filter does not remove or freeze the common V projection. Synthetic gradient tests cover the retained192 coefficients and common V projection.

checks.name: initialization_rng
checks.finding: One original CNN constructor initializes the common tensors and original kernels. Replacement reuses those objects and introduces only a deterministic uint8 identity buffer; no new random initialization or checkpoint warmstart. Direct wrapper is state/RNG-equivalent to the QK-only-then-single-location design inheritance. Synthetic tests compare Torch/Python/NumPy RNG and all retained tensors, all3 seeds and contexts32/84/256.

checks.name: forward_algebra
checks.finding: Independent stdlib AST comparison: resolving the candidate q/k branch makes its complete forward AST identical to original ObservedCausalQKVMemoryAttention.forward after deleting only the two unselected local-residual assignment statements. All subsequent memory concatenation, scoring, masking, softmax, dropout, output projection and query masking are unchanged.

checks.name: observed_boundaries_and_target_isolation
checks.finding: Inherited observed_context and causal_depthwise_residual preserve current/previous/second-previous observed taps, padding skip, withheld boundary reset and unavailable taps. Synthetic tests include NaN padding, future/target perturbation, short histories, batch consistency and unchanged evaluation state.

checks.name: memory_asymmetry
checks.finding: Memory tokens bypass the retained local filter. Query filtering changes query scores against both event and memory keys; Key filtering changes event keys before memory concatenation. Either can change normalized memory mass. This is the specified position asymmetry, not identical functional intervention on memory.

checks.name: common_training_conditions
checks.finding: Runner reuses original common training/replay functions and model input/head implementations. It validates hidden64, quantity loss1/tail0, unchanged recorded-time head, AdamW .001/.01/clip1, loader128, max300/min40/patience40, strict earliest finite full-Validation rawRMSE selection and no warmstart/force rerun. No added gate/norm/nonlinearity/RevIN/GRU activation.

checks.name: arm_identity_and_baseline_guard
checks.finding: Distinct metadata and state identity bind both selected and terminal states to the physical single-kernel arm. Complete state validation remains strict even load_state_dict(strict=False); forged cross-arm identity with wrong physical kernel, baseline relabel, missing/extra/dummy tensors and changed split/head/selector are rejected in synthetic tests. training_args allows only the two new candidates, not the CNN alias. Historical baseline comparison/reuse is an operational responsibility outside this model review; no historical CNN checkpoint/prediction was read or run here.

synthetic_tests.scope: Local fabricated inputs only; test fixture blocks polars read_parquet/scan_parquet. Random initial original-CNN synthetic comparison is not historical baseline inference or training.
